closest_comparator: The known below-BF result already rules out positive self-adjoint extensions. The present explicit Green identity also tests the stronger, non-self-adjoint prescription that kills both oscillatory amplitudes: its compact source range has one nontrivial moment at each Laplace frequency. This diagnoses an attempted use of stationary fast falloff as a dynamical exclusion, without invalidating the stationary compatible inverse.
